title: Introduce invocation-phase resonance and Token Credit Explorer
author: Priya Malhotra
description:
Motivation: Tail latency and token-cost spikes are often produced by correlated amplification across sequential stages of the inference pipeline (ingest -> preproc -> serving -> postproc). Existing samplers catch long tails but do not expose an explainable, per-tenant signal that ties these phase correlations to cost impact. This PR introduces a lightweight invocation-phase resonance sampler plus a Token Credit Explorer dashboard so SREs/product teams can see how 'resonant' invocations drive amortized token credits and downstream cost exposure.

What this changes (summary): Adds a runtime sampler that computes a compact resonance score by measuring normalized latency deviation across pipeline phases, labels spans with a token-credit anchor when resonance exceeds a configurable threshold, and emits a new metric series token_credit.anchor_count and token_credit.amortized to the metrics pipeline. Also ships a Grafana dashboard (Token Credit Explorer) with three panels: resonance histogram, tenant-level amortized credit sparkline, and correlated long-tail invocation table with direct links to compact traces. Finally, a small alert tuning change: alerts that monitored raw token-cost spikes are supplemented with a 'credit exhaustion' guard that suppresses noisy alerts for short-lived resonances.

Design notes: The resonance score is intentionally cheap: we use per-invocation z-score of phase latencies (windowed mean/variance) with an exponential decay so we avoid unbounded state. We attach a minimal span attribute (credit_anchor_id) for joinability in logs without increasing span size significantly. Sampling is conditional: only invocations that cross either the resonance threshold OR exceed a token-credit percentile are marked for higher-fidelity traces to keep telemetry costs bounded.

Rollout plan: Feature guarded behind feature flag rf:phase_resonance enabled for 5% of tenants for 48 hours, then 25% after monitoring, then 100% with automatic threshold autotune. Dashboard deployed to observability team namespace first; promoted to platform-monitoring namespace after signoff.

Testing: unit tests for resonance math, integration tests for span attribute propagation, e2e test that verifies metric emission and dashboard ingestion. Local benchmark shows sampler adds <0.7ms median overhead to request path at p99 tail test harness.

Risks and mitigations: False positives — we provide a tuned default threshold and an easy per-tenant opt-out. Telemetry cardinality — we only attach credit_anchor_id when sampling fires and keep anchor id namespace per-tenant to limit cross-tenant explosion.

Notes: This PR is telemetry-only (no model/runtime algorithm changes). Subsequent PRs will add an explore API to query amortized credits by tenant and correlate with billing exports.

release_notes: Introduce a low-overhead invocation-phase resonance sampler and Token Credit Explorer dashboard. Adds token_credit.anchor_count and token_credit.amortized metrics, a Grafana dashboard for investigating correlated phase-induced token-costs, and a credit-exhaustion alert gating rule. Feature is behind a rollout flag and initially enabled for a subset of tenants.
notes: Follow-up work: add an explore API for amortized credit queries (ENG-3507) and a tenant-level opt-out API for high-volume customers. Ensure billing export joins token_credit.amortized in next billing pipeline migration.
